card_text: XADO engine oils and revitalizant engine treatments in Singapore.
Buy online or ask for XADO at a listed workshop's oil change.
lede: XADO Singapore sells XADO engine oils and revitalizant engine treatments. XADO is a car-care brand founded in 1991, and its products are made under German and Dutch licences. The treatment is added at an oil change, so you can buy it online or have it fitted at one of the workshops listed on xado-shop.sg. WhatsApp 9339 1185 or call 6876 1456 to ask which product suits your car.

services.d: Added to fresh oil at an oil change. XADO states the treatment forms a protective ceramic-metal layer on worn engine parts. Versions for new cars, high-mileage cars and turbo engines.
Fully synthetic oils with revitalizant blended in, including the Luxury Drive and Atomic Oil range and a 0W20 for many modern Japanese engines.
services.p: Retail from $138 per 4L for the Black Edition oils

services.d: Transmission and power steering fluids in the XADO range.
Send your car model and mileage on WhatsApp and XADO Singapore points you to a product and a workshop near you.

faqs: The treatment is added to fresh engine oil at an oil change, or you choose an XADO oil that already has revitalizant blended in. No engine strip-down is needed.
Where can I get it fitted?
At one of the workshops listed on the xado-shop.sg workshop finder. WhatsApp the workshop, give your car model and mileage, and ask for XADO.
Yes, from the online shop at shop.xado-shop.sg.
Will it fix a broken engine part?
No. XADO describes the treatment as protecting and restoring worn friction surfaces, not repairing broken parts.
